Hi Katie — thanks for the clear list. We can provide an evidence pack and a short DPIA draft. High level answers up front:

- Runtime logs (application + request tracing): retained 90 days by default; access-controlled and audited.
- Backups (encrypted snapshots): retained up to 365 days by default; retention matrix attached; deletions are handled via scheduled overwrite and snapshot lifecycle policies (see backup_retention_matrix.csv).
- Prompts / request bodies: ephemeral by default. Prompts used for debugging are retained in primary logs for up to 30 days for triage and then purged; we can support a 24-hour ephemeral option for contracted customers. Details in prompt_handling_playbook.txt.
- Encryption: all backups encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS keys where requested; logs encrypted at rest and in transit.

I’m attaching: redwood_log_retention_policy_v2.pdf, backup_retention_matrix.csv, prompt_handling_playbook.txt. DPIA is in draft (dpia-draft-20261001.pdf); we’ll finish it after the client intake.

Hi Katie — attaching the evidence pack for your SIG review. Summary highlights below and attachments included for your assessment. Let me know if you prefer a redacted set for public SIG uploads.

Summary (quick answers):
- Runtime logs (access logs, request traces, debug logs): default retention = 90 days. Logs are encrypted at rest and in transit, access is role-based with audit logging. Automated purge job runs weekly; last completed 2026-09-15 (audit excerpt attached).
- Backups: full snapshots retained up to 365 days (primary); cold snapshots retained up to 730 days where requested. Incremental deltas retained 90 days. Deletion propagated via snapshot lifecycle policies; restores and delete operations are logged and auditable. All backups encrypted with KMS; we support customer-managed keys on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Prompt retention: default "debug" path retains prompts in primary logs for up to 30 days for triage; we document an opt-in 24-hour ephemeral mode for customers with heightened privacy needs. Prompts are not copied to long-term cold backups by default. If a customer requests prompt persistence to backups, that is a documented configuration change and requires explicit contract language.
- DPIA: draft attached (dpia-draft-20261001.pdf). It contains the data flow diagram for prompt handling, risk assessment, and recommended mitigations. We will finalize after intake and can provide a finalized copy as part of procurement.

Attachments included (stubs):

- backup_retention_matrix.csv — snapshot frequency, retention windows, KMS key notes.
- prompt_handling_playbook.txt — operational controls for prompt handling and opt-in ephemeral mode.
- dpia-draft-20261001.pdf — DPIA draft covering prompt data flows (work in progress).
